svg.title: Partition materials compared, edge view
svg.desc: Five partition doors side by side, each cut through and seen edge on at the same scale: phenolic 3/4 inch, layered kraft paper core with melamine faces and a machined, chamfered edge; solid plastic (HDPE) 1 inch, one solid sheet with a rounded edge; plastic laminate 1 inch, particleboard core with laminate on the faces and the edge; powder coated steel and stainless steel 1 inch, steel faces over a honeycomb core joined by a formed, interlocking edge molding.
svg.text: Same scale, each door cut through and seen edge on.
